profile.headline: Software Engineer at LaunchDarkly
profile.summary:
I'm a senior software engineer specializing in backend systems, distributed architectures, and reliability-focused software.
My experience spans Amazon, Divvy Homes, and Palantir, where I've worked on large-scale system migrations, workflow platforms, and data-intensive services. I enjoy solving complex engineering problems involving correctness, scalability, and operational reliability—whether that's migrating legacy systems, designing concurrency-safe workflows, or debugging challenging production issues.
Throughout my career, I've helped modernize critical infrastructure, improve system performance, and build services that support high-volume business operations. My technical background includes distributed systems, API design, asynchronous processing, cloud infrastructure, data pipelines, and production operations.
Technologies I work with include Java, TypeScript, Python, AWS, Kubernetes, Docker, SQL, and C++.
I'm particularly interested in backend, platform, and infrastructure challenges where thoughtful system design can have a meaningful impact. If you're working on difficult engineering problems or building scalable systems, I'd love to connect and exchange ideas.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Migrated a customer-facing pricing system from a 20+ year-old C++ monolith to a distributed 3-service Java architecture processing millions of orders per day, ensuring behavioral parity across all flows.

Debugged pricing discrepancies across multiple layers of allocation and discount logic, identifying and fixing a non-deterministic ordering bug affecting edge-case offers.

Expanded regression coverage using production diff cases, preventing parity regressions and unblocking migration-dependent feature work.

positions.title: Software Engineer/Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Rebuilt the maintenance-request backend workflow across thousands of homes into a structured system with dynamic intake, triage automation, escalation logic, and contractor integration.

Designed concurrency-safe contractor synchronization that prevented duplicate work orders under parallel processing via ordered execution and controlled re-queuing.

Reduced surfaced maintenance requests by ~50% through improved intake and automated triage.

Led migration of contract/document generation from a fragile third-party templating platform to an internally owned AWS Lambda-based service handling hundreds of monthly offers and thousands of generated documents.

Introduced feature-flagged rollout and rollback strategy, eliminating recurring outages and improving document generation throughput by ~2x.

positions.title: Data Engineer
positions.description:
Reduced invoice ingestion time from several hours to under 5 minutes by redesigning a third-party API pipeline to use incremental time-based synchronization.

Engineered robust downstream ingestion pipelines to handle incremental updates, validating correctness via automated integration suites under tight API constraints.

Built pipelines converting unstructured meeting emails into structured, searchable records with normalized metadata and internal linking.

Developed parsing logic to handle inconsistent real-world email formats, improving discoverability of operational data.
